title: Focalization span
description: Who perceives over a paragraph or a contiguous range of paragraphs (a scene, or part of one). Distinct from who narrates: the narrating voice is a slot of setting spans (setting.json). `internal`: the text renders what `focalizer` perceives or thinks; `zero`: an unrestricted narrator, no character's perception; `external`: only what an outside observer could see. Spans never overlap.

end.description: Last paragraph, inclusive. Absent: the span is the single paragraph `start`.

focalizer.description: The perceiving character. Required for `internal`, forbidden otherwise.
